p.src: 1  The LORD’s word that came to Hosea the son of Beeri, in the days of Uzziah, Jotham, Ahaz, and Hezekiah, kings of Judah, and in the days of Jeroboam the son of Joash, king of Israel.

ja: ベエリの子ホセアに臨んだ主 の言葉。これは、ユダの
ウジヤ、ヨタム、アハズ、ヒゼキヤの
ヨアシュの子ヤロブアムの
en: The LORD’s word that came to Hosea the son of Beeri, in the days of Uzziah, Jotham, Ahaz, and Hezekiah, kings of Judah, and in the days of Jeroboam the son of Joash, king of Israel.
u.src: 1  The LORD’s word that came to Hosea the son of Beeri, in the days of Uzziah, Jotham, Ahaz, and Hezekiah, kings of Judah, and in the days of Jeroboam the son of Joash, king of Israel.

ja: 1:1 すべて大文字の「主」または「神」は、神の固有名であるヘブル語「יהוה」（通常「ヤハウェ」と発音される）の訳である。
en: 1:1 When rendered in ALL CAPITAL LETTERS, “LORD” or “GOD” is the translation of God’s Proper Name (Hebrew “יהוה”, usually pronounced Yahweh).

p.src: 2  When the LORD spoke at first by Hosea, the LORD said to Hosea, “Go, take for yourself a wife of prostitution and children of unfaithfulness; for the land commits great adultery, forsaking the LORD.”

en: When the LORD spoke at first by Hosea, the LORD said to Hosea, “Go, take for yourself a wife of prostitution and children of unfaithfulness; for the land commits great adultery, forsaking the LORD.”
u.src: 2  When the LORD spoke at first by Hosea, the LORD said to Hosea, “Go, take for yourself a wife of prostitution and children of unfaithfulness; for the land commits great adultery, forsaking the LORD.”

p.src: 3  So he went and took Gomer the daughter of Diblaim; and she conceived, and bore him a son.

en: So he went and took Gomer the daughter of Diblaim; and she conceived, and bore him a son.
u.src: 3  So he went and took Gomer the daughter of Diblaim; and she conceived, and bore him a son.

p.src: 4  The LORD said to him, “Call his name Jezreel, for yet a little while, and I will avenge the blood of Jezreel on the house of Jehu, and will cause the kingdom of the house of Israel to cease.

ja: をイズレエルと名づけよ。もうしばらくすれば、私はイズレエルの
en: The LORD said to him, “Call his name Jezreel, for yet a little while, and I will avenge the blood of Jezreel on the house of Jehu, and will cause the kingdom of the house of Israel to cease.
u.src: 4  The LORD said to him, “Call his name Jezreel, for yet a little while, and I will avenge the blood of Jezreel on the house of Jehu, and will cause the kingdom of the house of Israel to cease.

p.src: 5  It will happen in that day that I will break the bow of Israel in the valley of Jezreel.”

en: It will happen in that day that I will break the bow of Israel in the valley of Jezreel.”
u.src: 5  It will happen in that day that I will break the bow of Israel in the valley of Jezreel.”

p.src: 6  She conceived again, and bore a daughter. Then he said to him, “Call her name Lo-Ruhamah, for I will no longer have mercy on the house of Israel, that I should in any way pardon them.

ja: をロ・ルハマと名づけよ。 私はもはやイスラエルの
en: She conceived again, and bore a daughter. Then he said to him, “Call her name Lo-Ruhamah, for I will no longer have mercy on the house of Israel, that I should in any way pardon them.
u.src: 6  She conceived again, and bore a daughter. Then he said to him, “Call her name Lo-Ruhamah, for I will no longer have mercy on the house of Israel, that I should in any way pardon them.

ja: 1:6 「ロ・ルハマ」は「愛されていない」という意味である。

p.src: 7  But I will have mercy on the house of Judah, and will save them by the LORD their God, and will not save them by bow, sword, battle, horses, or horsemen.”

en: But I will have mercy on the house of Judah, and will save them by the LORD their God, and will not save them by bow, sword, battle, horses, or horsemen.”
u.src: 7  But I will have mercy on the house of Judah, and will save them by the LORD their God, and will not save them by bow, sword, battle, horses, or horsemen.”

ja: 1:7 「神」と訳されたヘブル語は「אֱלֹהִים」（エロヒム）である。

p.src: 8  Now when she had weaned Lo-Ruhamah, she conceived, and bore a son.

en: Now when she had weaned Lo-Ruhamah, she conceived, and bore a son.
u.src: 8  Now when she had weaned Lo-Ruhamah, she conceived, and bore a son.

p.src: 9  He said, “Call his name Lo-Ammi, for you are not my people, and I will not be yours.

ja: づけよ。 あなたがたは私の
ではなく、私はあなたがたの
en: He said, “Call his name Lo-Ammi, for you are not my people, and I will not be yours.
u.src: 9  He said, “Call his name Lo-Ammi, for you are not my people, and I will not be yours.

ja: 1:9 「ロ・アンミ」は「私の民ではない」という意味である。

p.src: 10  Yet the number of the children of Israel will be as the sand of the sea, which can’t be measured or counted; and it will come to pass that, in the place where it was said to them, ‘You are not my people,’ they will be called ‘sons of the living God.’

ja: えることもできなくなる。かつて
らに『あなたがたは私の
ら』と呼ばれるようになる。
en: Yet the number of the children of Israel will be as the sand of the sea, which can’t be measured or counted; and it will come to pass that, in the place where it was said to them, ‘You are not my people,’ they will be called ‘sons of the living God.’
u.src: 10  Yet the number of the children of Israel will be as the sand of the sea, which can’t be measured or counted; and it will come to pass that, in the place where it was said to them, ‘You are not my people,’ they will be called ‘sons of the living God.’

p.src: 11  The children of Judah and the children of Israel will be gathered together, and they will appoint themselves one head, and will go up from the land; for great will be the day of Jezreel.

ja: ユダの子らとイスラエルの子らはともに
en: The children of Judah and the children of Israel will be gathered together, and they will appoint themselves one head, and will go up from the land; for great will be the day of Jezreel.
u.src: 11  The children of Judah and the children of Israel will be gathered together, and they will appoint themselves one head, and will go up from the land; for great will be the day of Jezreel.
